text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ and I are in the middle of
a
training session, timing her runs to
check her
performance.

I'm not making any personal bests today.
In fact,
my times are getting worse...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Urgh! If this continues—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I need to check something. I'll be
right
back.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What?! You're leaving already, Taishin?!
C'mon,
we should cheer her on a little
longer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: No thanks. I've seen enough.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hello, you two.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
OH! Hayahide! Fancy meeting you here!
Taishin
and I were just—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Watching me run, right? I know. That's
why I came
over here.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Please, don't leave yet. At least watch
me run one
more lap.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Why do you want us to stick around?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Because you just watched my last run.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm not performing at my
best
today...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I don't want you to think this is the best I
can do!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to embarrass myself with
such a
pitiful performance again. I'm
going to show you
your rival's true
potential!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Fine. You get one lap.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That's enough for me! Ticket, would you
also be
all right staying for one—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Of course I'll stay!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Why are you crying?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm just sooo honored that you consider me to be a rivaaal!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Hehe, well...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I feel the same way.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you time me once more?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I need to keep improving. I can't break
my
promise to them!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ runs her best time of the
month.

From that day onward, her running
improves
significantly.
